source: Newer accelerator generations support finer-grained block scaling. Current ZXNAME0000XZ Transformer Engine documentation, for example, describes MXFP8 on Blackwell-class hardware using local scaling for blocks of 32 values, and ZXNAME0001XZ as a supported 4-bit low-precision recipe.
zh: 较新的加速器一代支持更细粒度的块扩展。例如，当前的 ZXNAME0000XZ Transformer Engine 文档描述了 Blackwell 级硬件上的 MXFP8，使用 32 个值块的本地缩放，并将 ZXNAME0001XZ 作为受支持的 4 位低精度配方。
